title: What to expect on a Japan + South Korea group tour
excerpt: Temples, neon streets, palaces and markets — how we pace an East Asia group departure so nobody feels rushed.
author: WanderVista
seoTitle: Japan & South Korea Group Tour Preview | WanderVista
seoDescription: A practical look at our upcoming Japan and South Korea group journey: cities, pacing and what is included.
body:
Our next East Asia departure weaves Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka and Seoul into one guided group journey.

Days are built around signature sights — Senso-ji, Fushimi Inari, Gyeongbokgung — with time left for food streets and evening photographs.

Breakfast is included daily. Lunch and dinner stay flexible so the group can follow local recommendations.

Ask us for the full day-by-day itinerary and the next departure window.

title: How to pack for a WanderVista group tour
excerpt: A short packing list for first-time international group travellers — layers, documents and the extras that actually get used.
author: WanderVista
seoTitle: Packing list for international group tours | WanderVista
seoDescription: What to pack for a WanderVista group tour: documents, clothing and practical extras.
body:
Pack light layers, comfortable walking shoes and a small day bag for temple and market days.

Keep passports, visas, travel insurance and a paper copy of the itinerary in one document folder.

A universal adaptor, power bank and a refillable bottle cover most of the practical gaps.
